name: crosspet-plus-workspace
description: CrossPet characters with the complete Clawd on Desk runtime

scripts.setup: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop ci
scripts.start: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run build:win:x64
scripts.build:win:dir: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run build:win:dir
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run build:mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run build:linux
